nodes.label: D1 — Solar position and rise/set: port NOAA code
nodes.rationale: Porting NOAA algorithm avoids 230KB dependency and handles polar cases (midnight sun/polar night) distinguishably.

nodes.label: D4 — Building footprints through the platform
nodes.rationale: Reuses Overpass infrastructure for caching, rate limiting, and handling untrusted geometry at the platform boundary.

nodes.label: D6 — Shadows: DirectionalLight + orthographic camera
nodes.rationale: Uses ShadowMaterial for transparency over map imagery and orthographic camera to bound GPU cost and prevent spurious shadows.

nodes.label: D9 — Per-frame subscription during playback
nodes.rationale: Guarded callback ensures redraws are only requested during active playback to keep the viewer quiet when idle.

nodes.label: D13 — Buildings cast but are not drawn
nodes.rationale: Prevents 'ghost duplicate' visual bugs where OSM extrusions misalign with basemap 3D buildings; uses colorWrite: false.

nodes.label: D15 — Ground offset moves extension group
nodes.rationale: Translates the extension's own Drawing Space group in Z instead of re-anchoring the scene, preserving framework isolation.
